versions.changelog:
Initial release of dou-yin-data-insight:

- Provides Douyin (抖音) data access and analysis for competitor research, trend tracking, and content operation.
- Supports keyword-based video/search queries, creator post retrieval, video/comment analysis, and real-time hot list.
- Command line interface with structured JSON outputs.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access; works with Node.js 16.14.0+.
- Focused on safe, large-scale, and efficient extraction of public Douyin data for research and content optimization use cases.
